Incorporating the Financial Stability Report perspective slightly tempers the otherwise constructive read of the FOMC statement. The macro message remains moderately positive—strong labor markets, a strengthened outlook, and gradual, rules-consistent rate hikes with a symmetric 2% inflation goal. The FSR overlay, however, highlights elevated asset valuations and pockets of high corporate leverage that could amplify the effects of further tightening, even as core institutions are well capitalized and near-term funding risks remain low. Netting these, the tone is still mildly positive but with more caution around financial vulnerabilities than a purely macro read would suggest.
